		name = zin_mistake.10.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 70
			modifier = {
				add = 30
				zin_rules_is_historical = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = AEN
				NOT = { has_war_with = AEN }
			}
			declare_war_on = { target = AEN type = annex_everything }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = {
					zin_aenor_is_realm = yes
					NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT }
				}
			}
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					zin_aenor_is_realm = yes
					NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT }
				}
				save_event_target_as = zin_mistake_first_foe
			}
			declare_war_on = { target = event_target:zin_mistake_first_foe type = annex_everything }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = zin_mistake.10.b
		trigger = {
			country_exists = LER
			NOT = { has_war_with = LER }
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 20
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				zin_rules_is_historical = yes
			}
		}
		declare_war_on = { target = LER type = annex_everything }
	}

		name = zin_mistake.10.c
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				zin_rules_is_historical = yes

					zin_rules_is_historical = yes
					has_country_flag = zin_zol_accord_sought
				}
			}

			limit = { has_war_with = PUV }

		give_military_access = PUV
		PUV = { give_military_access = ZOL }

		PUV = { country_event = { id = zin_dominion.15 } }

# Proposed id. Fired to the Gala Elves 14 days after zin_mistake.22 A: if Kusven is still on the field and Lorien lives, Lorien dies forcing him back (O4).
country_event = {
	id = zin_mistake.26
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				zin_kusven_is_forth = yes
				NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_lorien_dead }
			}
			news_event = { id = zin_mistake.23 }
			zin_sun_lorien_falls = yes
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_cause = 0 }
			zin_kusven_withdraw = yes
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = zin_mistake.26.a
	}
